scope: V1 preparation protocol only; no candidate search, ranking, or selection

prior_exposure.declaration: The operator has prior exposure to Case 001 and the invalid duplicate recorded in RUN 021/022, but authored this protocol before any new candidate search, candidate evidence retrieval, scoring, or selection under B3.

candidate_eligibility.rule: Normalize the DOI using the B1 registry rule and hard-fail any DOI already present in registry/cases.yaml or elsewhere in the candidate set.
The article must be peer reviewed and published in accounting, auditing, or finance. FT50 is preferred but is not itself proof of eligibility.
A publicly accessible replication package must be identifiable with stable source location, provenance, access date, and license or reuse-status disclosure.
The public package must permit a documented mapping from at least one reported table or result to specific executable code.
At least one documented execution path must use Stata or Python, with entry point, execution order, environment requirements, and expected output location.
Each eligible candidate must identify at least one bounded result or construct that can be independently reproduced from public data without substituting for licensed-data results.
The candidate record must disclose all known prior operator, reviewer, and human exposure to the paper, package, expected results, and any earlier screening.

decision_authority.human: selects Case 002 and Case 003 after POC approval

stop_conditions: no executable Stata or Python path
unclear license or access status requiring human review
execution_gate: Candidate search and evidence retrieval are prohibited until this protocol has been independently reviewed and the human has recorded POC approval.
